item.title: Make your own tools
item.description: Make your own tools Don’t be afraid to create your own tools. If you need a specific tool for a specific job, don’t be afraid to create a new tool even if you have to reinvent the wheel. You’ll come out of it with a better understanding of the problem and hopefully with something customizable to your needs. Hey, maybe some other person will find it useful. That’s it.

item.title: Android, incremental builds and compilation times
item.description: Android, incremental builds and compilation times Productivity is all about minimizing bullshit. I feel that I’m constantly complaining about compilation times. Just create a new, empty Android project and see how much time it takes to have an application running in the device. It’s ridiculous. I’m far from being the only one complaining, it’s 2019, we have faster computers than ever. When Android’s Jack and Jill project was announced, I had a little bit of hope that things would get better.

item.title: Face keypoint detection
item.description: Face keypoint detection [Imported from an old blog. 25/08/2019] This hobby project started as a solution to the now finished Facial Keypoints detection kaggle competition While messing around with the dataset and reading the competition goal I realized that I was not really interested in the outcome. The original competition only has you predicting a few keypoints and not all images are annotated equally. The competition is over so that’s no fun also.

item.title: About
item.description: Hi there My name is Gonçalo. I’m a software developer, working out of Coimbra, Portugal. At my current job I work on Android applications with Java and Kotlin. I work with Applied AI and Machine Learning; Python, Rust, C++, OpenGL and Tensorflow in my spare time.

item.title: Showcase
item.description: This is a random assortment of projects I’ve worked on in the past. Spare Time Projects lcat - Colors, filters and annotates adb logcat output. fibre-wallpaper - Android Live Wallpaper timelapse - Command line utility to record timelapse video using a webcam gonet-nural - Small experiment in training a simple Tensorflow model using Python, exporting it and reimplementing it in C with minimal dependencies. adb-control-center - Proof-of-concept (barely works) interface for common android ADB commands used during development.
